# Museums: a merged bibliography

23165 works cited in the bibliographies and notes of 77 books and articles on museums (the files in `books/`). Works unrelated to museums, heritage, collecting, curation or exhibiting were removed (see `pipeline/removed.csv`). Duplicates are merged; “cited by” gives the number of those texts that cite a work, followed by the texts (number in brackets = the list below). 🔵 marks the works we hold. Entries were transcribed by reading agents and not checked one by one.

| Section | Works |
|---|---|
| 1. Secondary literature (historiography) | 11531 |
| 2. Primary sources (evidence) | 9842 |
| 3. Theoretical inspiration / frameworks | 1792 |
